response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t INNER JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT m.media_type_name, m.rate, m.track_count, m.rate - o.mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.rate > o.mean_rate

assumptions.assumption: Media types with the same name are combined, as requested by 'for each media type name'. A zero Milliseconds value has no defined ratio and is skipped by AVG.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat each MediaTypeId as a separate type, even if names repeat.
